reliability: This plugin does not implement a sandbox.
The file sandbox does not restrict reads, network access, or external services; the Windows backend reports `partial` enforcement.
The classifier is not an authority of its own.
Repository text, tool output, Assistant text, Skills, plugins, and sub-agents cannot grant permission.
Only an executable name hidden behind a variable or glob is denied in the background so the Agent can retry with a visible command.
Multiple targets, globs, variables, piped operands, or nested-interpreter deletion | deny in the background and require one visible literal target per call
Filesystem root, Home, DSH_HOME, system, or credential-critical paths | deny unconditionally
A renamed, replaced, or symlink-substituted path—or an old file moved into a new directory—loses automatic-cleanup status.
Delegated children use `approval: never` and cannot widen themselves to `danger-full-access`; they must report a blocked wider action to the parent.

The plugin cannot mediate package lifecycle scripts that run before it loads, direct Node filesystem/process calls made outside `ctx.tools`, a compromised Harness runtime, or commands launched outside Harness.
